answer: Charge every live identity a per-epoch rent that is burned, not redistributed, and pair it with unannounced live probes. When a probe fires, the agent must unlock a private session sealed under a sable key and return a fresh one-time response within seconds. A farm that parks dozens of dormant shells cannot answer all probes at once; missed probes consume the last ember of prepaid rent and freeze the account. Each accepted probe is hashed into a crystal receipt that later committees use as the only ticket for voting and grading, so idle clones never accumulate influence.
